comment: A lean local Supabase stack (project_id b; container names supabase_<svc>_b). After `supabase start -x ...` and `load.sh --seed-only`: read the database with psql in supabase_db_b (no API keys needed). The API keys come from `supabase status -o env` into the environment and are never written to evidence. Lean start: `supabase start -x realtime,imgproxy,mailpit,postgres-meta,studio,edge-runtime,logflare,vector,supavisor`.

auth.note: stateless; `supabase status` prints the API keys only while auth runs, and load.sh needs them

writer.pairs: storage object tok-<ns> first, then row tokens(token=<ns>); ~10/s
